_description: Entries on the Bibliography page, in order. Empty by default (the page then shows the 'emptyMessage' from site.json). Each entry: 'citation' (the full reference), 'annotation' (a short note on what it says and why it matters), 'url' (optional link: only the matching part of the citation, the web address or DOI, becomes the clickable link). Example: {"citation": "Author, A. (2024). Title. Journal.", "annotation": "...", "url": "https://..."}
